question: What CSS patterns cause layout thrashing?
shortAnswer: Forcing sync layout by reading geometry then writing styles in loops; animating layout props.
detailedAnswer: Batch reads/writes. Prefer transforms. Use DevTools performance panel.

question: How does CSS affect rendering pipeline stages?
shortAnswer: Styles → layout → paint → composite; some changes skip earlier stages.
detailedAnswer: Knowing what invalidates helps choose properties (transform vs top).

question: Critical CSS strategy?
shortAnswer: Inline minimal above-the-fold CSS; defer the rest; avoid huge inlined blobs.
detailedAnswer: Automate extraction carefully. Reassess as designs change.

question: Selector and stylesheet size — what to optimize?
shortAnswer: Remove dead CSS, split by route, avoid huge unused frameworks on critical path.
detailedAnswer: Purge carefully with dynamic class names. Compression + caching matter.

question: contain and content-visibility benefits?
shortAnswer: Hint browsers to isolate layout/paint work; skip rendering offscreen content.
detailedAnswer: content-visibility:auto can boost long pages. Need contain-intrinsic-size to reduce scrolljump.

question: Font loading performance with CSS?
shortAnswer: font-display strategies, subsetting, preload, limit weights.
detailedAnswer: FOIT/FOUT trade-offs. System font stacks for speed when brand allows.

question: Why are large box-shadows/filters costly?
shortAnswer: They can expand paint areas and be expensive on scroll/animate.
detailedAnswer: Prefer simpler shadows; animate opacity/transform on pre-promoted layers.

question: How do you find unused CSS?
shortAnswer: Coverage tool, PurgeCSS/UnCSS with caveats, design-system adoption metrics.
detailedAnswer: Dynamic classes and runtime CSS-in-JS complicate static purge.

question: CSS-in-JS runtime cost concerns?
shortAnswer: Runtime injection/hashing can cost CPU and delay paint vs static extraction.
detailedAnswer: Prefer zero-runtime or build-time extraction for critical UI when possible.

question: image-set and CSS backgrounds performance?
shortAnswer: Offer resolution/format alternatives; still prefer HTML img for content LCP.
detailedAnswer: Don't hide LCP content in CSS backgrounds.

question: Long lists: CSS techniques to help?
shortAnswer: content-visibility, virtualization (JS), avoid expensive per-item effects.
detailedAnswer: Pure CSS can't fully virtualize like windowing libraries.

question: Set a CSS performance budget for a team.
shortAnswer: Max critical CSS KB, banned properties for animation, lint rules, monitoring CLS/INP.
detailedAnswer: Encode in CI. Review third-party CSS.
